title: A template category shown on posts is renamed once on its archive; one no text replace can rename is reported on the first check and never keeps sweep rounds going
steps: S1: Plan a sweep (planSweep) for a WordPress site whose residue shows the template category 'Restaurant News' on two post pages, with the category's archive in the inventory.
S2: Plan the same residue on Joomla, and on WordPress with the category linked off the site.
expect: S1: exactly one rename call for the category, on its own archive route; no call on the post pages.
S2: no call; the category is listed unresolved and is not counted in the plan's `left`.
evidence: Dev 27/10/2026: a WordPress ja-diner demo check ran six sweep rounds in about an hour, planning the same category renames on post pages each round, and ended pass:false with four template category names still shown
fence: Category and tag rename planning in the residue sweep

tests: dev 27/10/2026: a template category shown on posts is renamed once, on its own archive, never per post page
a template category no text replace can rename is reported on the first check that sees it, never planned, never in `left`
